title: ranunculus acris subsp. nipponicus
intro: Ranunculus acris subsp. nipponicus, commonly known as Japanese buttercup, is a plant species in the Ranunculaceae family. This plant is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a popular choice for natural remedies. The health benefits of Ranunculus acris subsp. nipponicus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
